review_improvement: Prevents the title and placeholder SPEC from authorizing an invented GPU stress or false performance verdict.
independent_technical_reasoning: Bandwidth is path-specific: host-device PCIe, peer PCIe and NVLink have different topology ceilings and metrics. Without identifying the path and tool statistic, even a plausible GB/s number cannot be compared to a meaningful SPEC.
